summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited furnished a Form 6-K dated 18 September 2026, signed by Chief Financial Officer Charl Keyter, with an exhibit index listing a single market release (Exhibit 99.1). The body text is largely a binary JPEG rendering and discloses no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. Because no special-situation event is discernible from the available excerpt, it is treated as a routine foreign-private-issuer current report rather than an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or management change.
